purpose: Score-facing implementation readiness map for desktop/professional review; not an authorization to run services.

gates.pass_condition: manifest, bilingual mapping, metrics, matrices, self-check and local assets agree
official/professional inputs and rights constraints are identified before precision claims
ordinary, AI-off, stop, restore and exit routes reject unsafe branches
only after actual appointments, permits, baseline data, budget and insurance; currently zero
failures, objections and exit assets remain in the record

actions.acceptance_evidence: 包内路径、hash、自检状态、双语映射
actions.no_go_trigger: 文件缺失、hash不一致或双语映射失配

actions.title_zh: 官方底图与控规再基线
actions.acceptance_evidence: 替换清单、重算面积、保留provisional差异记录
actions.no_go_trigger: 官方数据缺失时不得进入精确红线/强度判断

actions.title_zh: 权属/许可/公众沟通案头筛查
actions.title_en: Rights, permission and public communication desktop screen
actions.minimum_input: 权属、文保、消防、无障碍、隐私、劳动与住房政策问题清单
actions.acceptance_evidence: 角色类型、待任命专业、不可触发事项
actions.accountable_role_type: 法务与社区沟通责任角色
actions.no_go_trigger: 未获授权不得联系住户、改变合同或安装设备

actions.title_zh: 十二场景合同桌面回放
actions.acceptance_evidence: 失败保留、普通路径、退出资产、人工接收回执
actions.accountable_role_type: 服务导航/独立审计角色
actions.no_go_trigger: 任何负例未被拒绝即退回合同修订

actions.title_zh: 可逆内装与住研邻接专业审查
actions.title_en: Reversible fit-out and live-research adjacency professional review
actions.minimum_input: 房间授权、构件清单、噪声/安全阈值、恢复方法
actions.acceptance_evidence: go/no-go表、恢复清单、人工签字模板
actions.accountable_role_type: 建筑/消防/无障碍/安全角色
actions.no_go_trigger: 无授权场地、无校准仪器或无恢复条件即停

actions.minimum_input: 设备清单、数据流、撤回、断网、纸本/人工路径
actions.acceptance_evidence: 未授权传输零容忍条件、撤回后基本功能清单
actions.accountable_role_type: 数据保护/住户权益角色
actions.no_go_trigger: 出现个人/家庭评分、隐性分配或无AI路径缺失即停

actions.minimum_input: 众智园、AI原点、大钟寺各自的入口、动线、责任、未知项
actions.acceptance_evidence: 站点回执、暂停/恢复条件、外部输入清单
actions.accountable_role_type: 片区统筹/运营责任角色
actions.no_go_trigger: 没有真实机构接收或现场条件即不进入G3

actions.title_zh: 公开复核、退役或限定深化
actions.title_en: Public review, retirement or limited development
actions.minimum_input: 失败、异议、撤回、成本、容量、普通路径等分母
actions.acceptance_evidence: 继续/修订/退役/重开登记决定记录
actions.accountable_role_type: 批准责任角色/公众复核角色
actions.no_go_trigger: 不能公开失败或退出资产不完整即退役
